content: If you miss a dose of your medication, apply it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one. Store this medication at room temperature and avoid refrigeration. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed, following local disposal regulations. This information was last updated in May 2024. It is important to note that this document provides a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your specific situation. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your individual health needs. To use this medication, apply it only to the skin. Clean and thoroughly dry the affected area before application. Apply a thin layer of the medication to the affected area and the surrounding skin, typically once or twice daily as directed on the product packaging. If you have any questions, consult your doctor or pharmacist. Wash your hands after application unless the treated area includes your hands. Avoid applying the medication to the eyes, nose, mouth, or inside the vagina. Do not use more of the medication or apply it more frequently than directed. Use the medication regularly to achieve the best results and continue using it for the full treatment period, even if symptoms improve after a few days. The condition may continue to improve after completing the full treatment. In some cases, it may take several weeks for the infection to completely heal. Possible side effects include burning, irritation, or itching at the application site. If your doctor has prescribed this medication, they have determined that the benefits outweigh the risks of side effects. Serious allergic reactions to this medication are rare. This is not a complete list of potential side effects. In the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for similar guidance. Before using terbinafine, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, other allylamine antifungals (such as naftifine), or any other substances. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. It is unknown if this drug passes into breast milk when applied to the skin. However, other forms of this medication, when taken orally, do pass into breast milk. Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. If someone overdoses on this medication and experiences severe symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. In the United States, you can call 1-800-222-1222. When using this medication to treat pityriasis, note that your normal skin color may not return immediately.
